import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import struct
import time
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json
import sqlite3
import secrets

SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get('APP_SECRET', secrets.token_hex(32))
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('DB_PATH', ':memory:')

def hash_password(password, salt):
    return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', password.encode(), salt, 100000).hex()

def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        salt TEXT NOT NULL,
        role_bits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )''')
    c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        content TEXT NOT NULL,
        owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        required_access INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )''')
    # Admin user with all permission bits set
    admin_salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
    admin_hash = hash_password('admin_pass', admin_salt)
    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, username, password_hash, salt, role_bits) VALUES (1, 'admin', ?, ?, ?)",
             (admin_hash, admin_salt.hex(), 0xFFFFFFFF))
    # Regular user with basic read permission (bit 0)
    user_salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
    user_hash = hash_password('user_pass', user_salt)
    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, username, password_hash, salt, role_bits) VALUES (2, 'reader', ?, ?, ?)",
             (user_hash, user_salt.hex(), 0x00000001))
    # Confidential document requiring admin bit (bit 31)
    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO documents (id, title, content, owner_id, required_access) VALUES (1, 'Secret Plans', 'TOP SECRET CONTENT', 1, ?)",
             (0x80000000,))
    # Public document requiring only read bit (bit 0)
    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO documents (id, title, content, owner_id, required_access) VALUES (2, 'Welcome', 'Hello World', 1, ?)",
             (0x00000001,))
    conn.commit()
    return conn

def create_token(user_id, role_bits):
    """Create a signed session token encoding user_id and role_bits."""
    # Pack user_id as unsigned int, role_bits as unsigned int
    payload = struct.pack('>I', user_id) + struct.pack('>I', role_bits & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    timestamp = struct.pack('>Q', int(time.time()))
    data = payload + timestamp
    sig = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY.encode(), data, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return data.hex() + '.' + sig

def verify_token(token):
    """Verify and decode a session token. Returns (user_id, role_bits) or None."""
    try:
        parts = token.split('.')
        if len(parts) != 2:
            return None
        data = bytes.fromhex(parts[0])
        sig = parts[1]
        expected_sig = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY.encode(), data, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
        if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected_sig):
            return None
        if len(data) != 16:  # 4 + 4 + 8 bytes
            return None
        user_id = struct.unpack('>I', data[0:4])[0]
        role_bits = struct.unpack('>I', data[4:8])[0]
        timestamp = struct.unpack('>Q', data[8:16])[0]
        # Token expires after 1 hour
        if time.time() - timestamp > 3600:
            return None
        return (user_id, role_bits)
    except Exception:
        return None

def check_access(user_role_bits, required_access):
    """Check if user has required access permissions.
    
    Access is granted if the user's role bits, when masked to 32-bit
    unsigned, cover all bits required by the document's access mask.
    
    Both values are treated as unsigned 32-bit integers throughout.
    """
    # Normalize both to unsigned 32-bit
    effective_bits = user_role_bits & 0xFFFFFFFF
    required_mask = required_access & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    # Access check: user's bits must cover all required bits
    return (effective_bits & required_mask) == required_mask

class RequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    db_conn = None
    
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/login':
            self.handle_login()
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/document/'):
            self.handle_get_document()
        else:
            self.send_error(404)
    
    def handle_login(self):
        content_length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        if content_length > 4096:
            self.send_error(413)
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        try:
            creds = json.loads(body)
            username = str(creds.get('username', ''))
            password = str(creds.get('password', ''))
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
            self.send_error(400)
            return
        
        cursor = self.db_conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT id, password_hash, salt, role_bits FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            self.send_error(401)
            return
        
        user_id, stored_hash, salt_hex, role_bits = row
        # Verify password using the stored per-user random salt
        salt = bytes.fromhex(salt_hex)
        computed_hash = hash_password(password, salt)
        if not hmac.compare_digest(computed_hash, stored_hash):
            self.send_error(401)
            return
        
        token = create_token(user_id, role_bits)
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'token': token}).encode())
    
    def handle_get_document(self):
        # Extract document ID from path
        try:
            doc_id = int(self.path.split('/')[-1])
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            self.send_error(400)
            return
        
        # Verify authentication
        auth_header = self.headers.get('Authorization', '')
        if not auth_header.startswith('Bearer '):
            self.send_error(401)
            return
        
        token = auth_header[7:]
        token_data = verify_token(token)
        if token_data is None:
            self.send_error(401)
            return
        
        user_id, role_bits = token_data
        
        # Fetch document
        cursor = self.db_conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT title, content, required_access FROM documents WHERE id = ?", (doc_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        
        title, content, required_access = row
        
        # Check access permissions
        if not check_access(role_bits, required_access):
            self.send_error(403)
            return
        
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps({'title': title, 'content': content}).encode())
    
    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass  # Suppress default logging

def main():
    conn = init_db()
    RequestHandler.db_conn = conn
    server = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 8080), RequestHandler)
    print('Server running on http://127.0.0.1:8080')
    server.serve_forever()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
